metadata.ffmpeg_version: 7.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev built with gcc 14.2.0 (Rev1, Built by MSYS2 project)

scan.note: Technical signals only. Continuous visual review and user approval remain separate.

scope: Independent one-model M02 and both W41-003 looks research candidate. Original publishing movies preserved.
editing: Original24fps speed; source interval trims only; no text/audio/crop/zoom/freeze/retime.
timing_reason: 4.5s per seated source keeps the attention change and near-frontal return; actual12.75s replaces provisional11.25s budget.

research_cost.note: Incremental transfer trial, not from-zero or proven efficiency.

visual_review.method: New L02 source: all145 thumbnails,25 larger checkpoints,5 face checkpoints and native frames36/108/144 viewed. Combined film: all306 thumbnails,25 larger checkpoints,5 face checkpoints and23 frames at each of3 joins covering every18-frame dissolve viewed.
visual_review.source_findings: L02 remains seated, attention turns to image-right, returns near-front around4–4.5s; hands and bag supported, shirt collar/short hems/denim waist and cafe objects broadly steady. No gross abrupt identity/clothing/contact/background change seen at inspected resolution.

joins.S1_S2: Different standing/seated body scale and focal height; clear double face/body/door/stool outlines in0.75s blend. Same accepted seated image differs in bag/hem geometry from original full source.
joins.S2_S3: Seated framing closer than full/seated but L02 head is higher and larger, pose differs slightly and source lighting brighter. Visible overlapping faces/hands/stool/plant. Not an invisible outfit change.
joins.S3_S4: Seated/full body scale and position differ, source backdrop/planter/stool viewpoints change; visible overlapping outlines. New join comfort requires whole-film viewing.

visual_review.limits: Sampled appearance plus all-thumbnail review, not a full native resolution every-frame pass or continuous normal-speed playback. Does not establish delivery template, reduced active labor or IG performance.

user_feedback.user_quote: 轉場手法與前面都差不多
user_feedback.context: Response to exact12.75s film review asking about3x0.75s dissolve, rhythm and wardrobe readability.
user_feedback.interpretation: User identifies similar transition method. This is novelty feedback, not explicit whole-film acceptance or blanket rejection of previous accepted movies.
user_feedback.editorial_response: Stop treating another model/scene on the same four-shot dissolves as a new transition experiment. Retain transfer-source/cost evidence. Next plan a visibly different camera/scene-based join; no new media or universal transition adoption in this feedback step.
user_feedback.next_hypothesis: Physical foreground occlusion carrying a directional camera movement, under existing soft-switch preference; first examine an actual reference and test one join before complete film generation.
